about: Hashtag pool for Maker Faire Kochi captions. Source of truth: pick a caption's hashtags from here (README, 'Keywords and hashtags'). prepare.py and phone.py check every caption's hashtag line against this file. Hashtags label a post and link it to a topic and community; they are not keywords (the bracketed list) and they don't raise reach. Post counts are Instagram totals reported by the sources named, as of the date given; re-measure every few months and record the date.
pattern: #MakerFaireKochi #MakerFaire, then 1-2 vertical tags, then 1 place tag (3-5 in all). Prefer tags of about 15K to 5M posts; larger ones bury a post, smaller ones have no audience.

always.why: Ours: the feed of everything about the Faire. First on every post; ask exhibitors and visitors to use it.
The global Maker Faire community's own tag, promoted by official Faires (makerfaire.com).

place.use: Default: the Faire, the venue city, Kochi's makerspaces.
Kerala-wide posts: volunteer calls, Kerala's making traditions, makers from across the state.

movement.label: Maker Faire and the maker movement
movement.for: What Maker Faire is, its history, the global network, what travels between Faires

tags.note: the broader variant; use one of the two movement tags, not both

kerala-makes.label: Kerala and Kochi make
kerala-makes.for: Kerala's own making (repair shops, kitchens, campuses, workshops), Kochi's place in the network
kerala-makes.note: Lead with the place tag here; usually #Kerala, or #Kochi for Kochi-specific posts

makerspaces.label: Makerspaces, Fab Labs and institutions
makerspaces.for: Super Fab Lab, Tinker Space, campus labs, the infrastructure that enables makers; why Kochi

tags.note: large and full of cosplay and miniatures; only when the post is about printing itself

craft.label: Craft, art and handloom
craft.for: Not just tech: textiles, handloom, art, handmade objects

repair.label: Repair and reuse
repair.for: Repair is making, fixing, reuse, upcycling

prototyping.label: Prototyping and version one
prototyping.for: First versions, failed attempts, iterating, building to learn

young-makers.label: Kuttimakers, students and learning
young-makers.for: Young makers, schools, campuses, curiosity, STEM

maker-stories.label: Maker Stories and the people
maker-stories.for: Profiles and interviews of makers; who counts as a maker; sharing over winning
maker-stories.note: Add the maker's own discipline tag (electronics, craft, repair, ...)

call-for-makers.label: Call for makers and exhibitors
call-for-makers.for: Interest form, take part, showcase your project

startups.label: Startups and innovation
startups.for: Hardware startups, founders, the startup ecosystem

avoid.why: Mostly woodworking and crafts; a different crowd (Flick related tags)
Too broad to be seen in
Broad, global charity and causes; use #VolunteersNeeded

rules: At most 5 hashtags per post or reel, caption and comments together (Instagram, Dec 2025). Put them in the caption, never a first comment.
The hashtag line is the caption's last line, after the bracketed keywords. Keywords are search words; hashtags are labels. Each keeps its own line.
#MakerFaireKochi first, #MakerFaire second, then vertical tags, then the place tag.
CamelCase, ASCII only (phone.py types captions over adb; screen readers read CamelCase as words).
No year or date tags until the event date is announced (no event date in our copy).
Stories have no caption and no hashtags.
A tag not in this pool is added here first, with its measured post count, source and date.
